Asset & Lease Manager

Own the administration of a multi-site U.S. retail lease portfolio: abstract leases, track critical dates, verify every landlord charge before it is paid, and recover overbilled CAM and tax charges.

Work Setup

  • Full-time, Monday–Friday, night shift
  • Must have a computer/laptop with a webcam
  • Reliable high-speed internet

What You'll Do

  • Abstract every executed lease and amendment (rent, escalations, CAM/tax/insurance terms, options, notice windows, exclusives, co-tenancy) into the lease database.
  • Maintain the critical date calendar (options, renewals, termination rights, TI deadlines, insurance renewals, estoppels) and give advance notice.
  • Route and file leases, amendments, estoppels, SNDAs and consents, and keep an indexed digital lease file.
  • Set up rent records at commencement and keep escalations, amendments and abatements current.
  • Validate every monthly billing (base rent, CAM, tax, insurance, percentage rent) against the lease before payment, and prepare the payment file for Accounting.
  • Manage the outsourced CAM and tax audit, review findings against the lease, and track approved claims through to credit or refund.
  • Screen year-end reconciliations on receipt and correct errors right away.
  • Track real estate tax bills and assessments, verify pro-rata shares, and flag protest candidates.
  • Issue and maintain certificates of insurance for every location to each lease's requirements.
  • Monitor landlord obligations and put landlords on notice when they are unmet.
  • Maintain W-9s, landlord and property manager records, and payment instructions, with verified controls on any banking changes.
  • Support franchisor and lender consent, estoppel and reporting requests.
  • Act as the day-to-day contact for property managers on statements, reconciliations, certificates and documents.
  • Prepare and file TI allowance draw packages and track them through to receipt.
  • Support back-charge claims and portfolio events such as closures, relocations, assignments and subleases.
  • Keep the lease database accurate, and produce recurring reports (critical dates, rent roll, occupancy cost, audit savings, insurance compliance).
  • Write and maintain SOPs, and help define, train and supervise a future associate role.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in U.S. retail or commercial lease administration, lease accounting or property accounting, ideally with multi-site portfolios
  • Ability to read and accurately abstract U.S. shopping-center leases, including CAM, tax and insurance pass-throughs, caps, exclusions, options and notice requirements
  • Working knowledge of CAM and real estate tax reconciliations, with the ability to spot improper charges and hold a position with landlords or audit firms
  • Experience managing certificates of insurance against lease-specific requirements
  • Advanced Excel
  • Excellent written and spoken English for direct, professional correspondence with U.S. landlords and property managers
  • Exceptional accuracy and follow-through, and comfort owning a deadline calendar where a missed date has real financial consequences
  • Preferred: a degree in Accounting, Finance, Real Estate, Business or Law
  • Preferred: experience with a lease administration platform, e-signature tools and an ERP/AP system
  • Preferred: experience supporting a growing portfolio (new openings, TI collection) or working with a U.S.-based team from offshore

We’re hiring a proactive, persuasive Leasing Sales Specialist to help fill and manage approximately 60 mobile home units. This role combines lead conversion, leasing, customer communication, and consistent follow-up.

This is not an administrative position. Your primary responsibility is to convert inquiries into property tours, tours into completed applications, and qualified applicants into signed leases. You must be confident speaking with prospects, uncovering their needs, overcoming objections, and clearly communicating why our properties are the right choice.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Conversion and Leasing

  • Respond quickly and professionally to inbound calls, texts, and messages
  • Build rapport with prospects and identify their housing needs
  • Clearly communicate property features, benefits, availability, and next steps
  • Convert qualified inquiries into scheduled property tours
  • Confirm appointments and reduce showing no-shows
  • Follow up with prospects before and immediately after property tours
  • Encourage interested prospects to complete rental applications
  • Address questions and objections that may prevent prospects from applying
  • Guide applicants through the application process and follow up until completion
  • Review applications for completeness before submitting them for approval
  • Maintain accurate notes and track every prospect through the leasing pipeline

Listing Management

Manage and update property listings across platforms such as:

  • Zillow
  • MH Village
  • Trulia
  • HotPads
  • Facebook Marketplace and Groups

Ensure listings are accurate, appealing, current, and optimized to generate qualified inquiries.

Showing Coordination

  • Coordinate with property supervisors to ensure tours occur smoothly and on time
  • Prepare prospects before their scheduled tours
  • Collect feedback from supervisors following each tour
  • Contact prospects promptly after tours while interest is still high
  • Relay updates between prospects and the internal team

Tenant Retention and Growth

  • Manage lease-renewal communications and follow-ups
  • Build positive relationships with current tenants
  • Identify opportunities to convert qualified renters into mobile home owners

Requirements

  • Proven sales, leasing, real estate, or lead-conversion experience
  • Strong spoken and written English
  • Natural, conversational, and confident telephone presence
  • Ability to build trust and rapport quickly
  • Experience overcoming objections and guiding prospects toward a decision
  • Strong follow-up and closing skills
  • Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple active leads
  • Comfortable being measured against conversion-based KPIs
  • Experience with property-listing platforms is preferred
  • Reliable internet and availability during required U.S. working hours

What Success Looks Like

  • Fast response times
  • High inquiry-to-tour conversion
  • Strong tour-to-application conversion
  • Strong application-to-lease conversion
  • Consistent pre-tour and post-tour follow-up
  • Complete and organized pipeline records
  • No qualified leads slipping through the cracks
  • Increasing occupancy across all properties

Yugo is a global leader in student housing dedicated to creating exceptional living experiences for students around the world. With a presence spanning more than 14 countries and 120 cities, Yugo combines innovation, community, and purpose to redefine student living. In the U.S., Yugo operates nearly 40,000 beds across 88 properties in 28 states, delivering vibrant communities designed to support student success both personally and professionally. Guided by its Live Your Best Life philosophy, Yugo fosters sustainability, personal growth, and career development while building an inclusive, collaborative, and forward-thinking culture for residents and team members alike.

As the Regional Leasing Specialist (RLS) you will partner with Regional Managers and onsite teams to drive leasing performance across an assigned portfolio. This role develops and executes portfolio leasing strategies using market trends, performance metrics, and operational data while ensuring leasing and marketing initiatives are consistently executed. The RLS provides hands-on coaching, training and operational support to Leasing Managers and onsite teams, fostering a culture built on our values of Pioneering, Purposeful and Positive.

This position requires travel up to 50%, with increased travel during peak leasing seasons and business needs.

Requirements

Reporting to the Director of Leasing, here’s what you’ll be doing!

  • Own the leasing strategy for an assigned portfolio by analyzing KPIs, market trends, competitor activity, and operational data to drive occupancy and leasing performance.
  • Lead weekly portfolio business reviews with Regional Managers to evaluate performance, analyze key metrics, identify opportunities, and develop action plans.
  • Partner with Regional Managers to ensure leasing and marketing initiatives are executed while collaboratively evaluating and implementing leasing specials and concession strategies.
  • Hold onsite teams accountable for leasing execution, lead management, follow-up expectations, and marketing initiatives.
  • Train and develop Leasing Managers and onsite teams on leasing platforms, leasing expectations, company processes, and best practices.
  • Coach teams on effective leasing techniques, including closing, creating urgency, asking for the lease, lead management, customer experience, and tour execution.
  • Develop market expertise by monitoring competitor activity, student demographics, and market trends to recommend portfolio strategies.
  • Audit property websites, social media, flyers, digital advertising, and on-the-ground marketing efforts to ensure brand standards and leasing effectiveness.
  • Review and approve digital advertising requests or provide recommendations to optimize digital marketing strategy and lead generation.
  • Support the rollout and execution of company-wide and global leasing and marketing initiatives.
  • Build strong partnerships with Regional Managers and onsite teams while promoting accountability, collaboration, and a positive culture that reflects our values of Pioneering, Purposeful, and Positive.

Sound good so far? Here’s what you’ll need to thrive in this role!

  • Minimum of three years’ of student housing, multifamily, or related leasing experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, a related field, or its equivalent, preferred. In lieu of degree, equivalent experience in residential properties, rental operations, or related business operations is required.
  • Experience coaching and developing leasing teams
  • Willingness to travel 50% of the time or more during peak seasons
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable leasing strategies
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to build and maintain quality relationships
  • Experience within a fast paced, target driven environment with strong focus on sales and marketing
  • Be proficient in working with technology and adaptable to online systems.
  • Be proficient in property management software’s such as Entrata, Yardi, Real Page or like systems
  • Carbon Literacy Certification or willingness to undertake training

Benefits

As part of the Yugo team, you are eligible for a competitive salary, bonus eligibility, comprehensive benefits and more! Here’s a snapshot of what we offer;

  • Competitive salary
  • Generous benefits package! Including health, dental and vision
  • 401k + 4% employer matching
  • Three weeks of PTO
  • Paid Wellness Time
  • 11 paid Holidays
  • Minimum one-week paid wellness time
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • 1 Paid Volunteer Day
  • 1 Paid YuDay
  • Company paid STD, LTD and Life insurance

At Yugo, we believe in creating a culture where everyone belongs and feels empowered to do their best work. If you're looking to make an impact in a people-first environment, apply today!

Property Management | Team Leadership | Leasing | Maintenance | Operations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: LATAM (Supporting Miami & Orlando, Florida Markets)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Operations Manager to lead the day-to-day operations of a growing property management company serving residential rental owners and tenants throughout the Miami and Orlando markets.

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for overseeing leasing operations, maintenance coordination, rent collections, client relationships, renewals, and overall property performance. You’ll lead a team of six professionals while driving operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement across the business.

You’ll work closely with leadership, property owners, tenants, vendors, and internal teams to ensure properties remain profitable, well-managed, and deliver an exceptional experience for everyone involved.

If you’re an experienced property management leader who enjoys building high-performing teams, improving operational processes, and delivering measurable results, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Team Leadership & Operations

  • Lead daily operations across the Miami and Orlando property portfolio.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop teams across:
    • Leasing
    • Operations
    • Maintenance Coordination
    • Business Development
  • Conduct weekly team meetings and performance reviews.
  • Establish KPIs and accountability across departments.
  • Allocate resources to ensure efficient operations.
  • Drive consistency through standardized processes and operational improvements.

Leasing & Occupancy Management

  • Oversee leasing operations and vacancy management.
  • Ensure listings remain accurate, competitive, and effectively marketed.
  • Monitor occupancy trends and leasing performance.
  • Improve lease renewal rates and rental pricing strategies.
  • Reduce vacancy periods while maintaining tenant quality.
  • Track leasing KPIs and implement performance improvements.

Unit Turns & Property Operations

  • Oversee the complete unit turn process.
  • Coordinate vendors, maintenance teams, and internal staff.
  • Ensure units are completed on time and within budget.
  • Monitor turn costs and identify operational efficiencies.
  • Verify units meet company quality standards before occupancy.

Owner & Client Relations

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for property owners.
  • Build long-term owner relationships through proactive communication.
  • Respond promptly to owner concerns and operational questions.
  • Oversee onboarding of new properties and clients.
  • Drive owner retention through exceptional service.

Maintenance Coordination

  • Oversee maintenance operations and vendor performance.
  • Monitor work orders and response times.
  • Coordinate communication between tenants, owners, and vendors.
  • Ensure inspections are completed on schedule.
  • Track maintenance costs while maintaining service quality.

Financial Operations & Collections

  • Oversee rent collection processes.
  • Monitor delinquency reports and collection performance.
  • Ensure notices and legal actions are initiated when appropriate.
  • Support eviction processes in accordance with company procedures and local regulations.
  • Monitor maintenance and operational expenses.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability while maintaining excellent service.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Develop scalable operational workflows and SOPs.
  • Implement accountability systems and performance reporting.
  • Improve operational efficiency through automation and technology.
  • Ensure consistent adoption of company systems and processes.
  • Continuously improve owner, tenant, and employee experiences.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 3+ years of residential property management experience.
  • 2+ years of leadership or operations management experience.
  • Experience managing cross-functional property management teams.

Core Knowledge

Strong understanding of:

  • Leasing
  • Vacancy management
  • Unit turns
  • Maintenance coordination
  • Rent collections
  • Lease renewals
  • Evictions
  • Residential property operations

Core Skills

  • Fluent English and Spanish communication (written and verbal).
  • Strong leadership and coaching abilities.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience managing remote teams.
  • Strong relationship management and communication skills.
  • Ability to oversee multiple properties and competing priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing operations across multiple geographic markets.
  • Experience with residential and commercial property management.
  • Experience implementing KPIs and operational reporting.
  • Hands-on experience using:
    • Buildium
    • QuickBooks
    • Monday.com
  • Experience leveraging automation and technology to improve operations.

Tools & Technologies

  • Buildium (Preferred)
  • QuickBooks
  • Monday.com
  • Google Workspace
  • Property Management Software
  • Communication & Collaboration Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Proven leader who develops high-performing teams.
  • Organized with exceptional follow-through.
  • Strong decision-maker who thrives under pressure.
  • Excellent communicator with owners, tenants, vendors, and employees.
  • Results-driven and highly accountable.
  • Comfortable balancing customer experience with operational and financial performance.
  • Self-directed and proactive in remote environments.
  • Passionate about improving systems and processes.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Meet with department leads and team members.
  • Review leasing performance, occupancy, and vacancies.
  • Monitor maintenance requests and vendor performance.
  • Follow up with owners and oversee onboarding activities.
  • Review rent collections and delinquency reports.
  • Coordinate unit turns and property inspections.
  • Track KPIs and operational performance.
  • Resolve escalated issues and remove operational bottlenecks.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and service quality.

In short: You lead the entire property management operation—ensuring teams perform at a high level, owners remain satisfied, tenants receive exceptional service, and the business continues to grow efficiently.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Occupancy rate.
  • Average days-to-fill vacancies.
  • Unit turn completion time.
  • Turn costs versus budget.
  • Rent collection rate.
  • Delinquency and eviction performance.
  • Lease renewal rate.
  • Rental rate growth on renewals.
  • Work order completion and resolution times.
  • Maintenance cost per unit.
  • Inspection completion rate.
  • Owner satisfaction and retention.
  • Team performance and accountability.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-impact leadership role with significant operational ownership.
  • Opportunity to lead and develop a growing property management team.
  • Direct influence on customer experience, profitability, and business growth.
  • Fully remote leadership opportunity.
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented culture.
  • Opportunity to improve systems, processes, and operational performance.
  • Clear career progression into:
    • Director of Operations
    • Regional Property Manager
    • VP of Property Operations
    • COO

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Property Management Operations Assessment
  4. Final Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

Apply today and help lead a growing property management organization to its next stage of success.

Across eight global destinations — Sintra (Portugal), Syros (Greece), Tuscany (Italy), Andalusia (Spain), Kotor (Montenegro), Bali (Indonesia), Kamakura (Japan), and La Barra (Uruguay) — we offer families the infrastructure to spend one, three, or 6+ months living in a new country: fully furnished homes, dedicated coworking hubs, and our own academy project based learning programs for children ages 1.5 -14.9 years old.

Our members are professionals, entrepreneurs, remote workers, and their families who want their children to grow up as global citizens without pausing their careers or their kids' education. We are asset-light where we can be, hybrid where it makes sense, and long-term partners with our landlords and local communities in every market we enter.

The future of family life and work is global, seamless, and community-driven — and we are building it. Join us as we scale toward our next wave of destinations across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

Boundless Life is seeking a highly capable Real Estate Legal Transaction Manager to join our Real Estate & Expansion team and support the growth of our global portfolio across eight active markets today, an active expansion pipeline.

Boundless Life operates across eight very different legal environments — from Portuguese and Spanish commercial lease frameworks to Indonesian Hak Pakai regimes, Italian, Greek, and Montenegrin civil law traditions, and Japanese and Uruguayan market practice — with active expansion pipeline (France, Costa Rica) adding further complexity. Candidates must be comfortable quickly grasping the intricacies of new jurisdictions, working through unfamiliar frameworks with local counsel, and holding the commercial line while doing so.

This position reports to the General Counsel, with a strong working line into the Head of Real Estate & Expansion. Location is flexible (remote-friendly, EMEA time zone preferred), with regular travel expected to active and prospective markets.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Commercial Property Manager supports the day-to-day operations of a commercial property in Indianapolis, keeping leasing, tenant requests, maintenance, property information, and documentation moving without constant supervision.

You will manage multiple active workflows at once, including prospective tenant and application activity, lease paperwork, move-ins and move-outs, maintenance requests, vacancy updates, floor plan changes, tenant concerns, events, and property documents. The role requires consistent follow-through: identifying what needs to happen next, gathering missing information, coordinating with tenants, vendors, architects, and the property team, and tracking each item through completion.

This is an execution-heavy role for someone who can work independently, manage competing priorities, and make sound decisions about when to act, when to follow up, and when to escalate. You should not need a daily task list to stay productive or wait for someone else to tell you the next step.

If you are strongest in narrowly defined administrative tasks and require frequent direction to move work forward, this role is not a fit.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Property Marketing and Vacancy Updates

• Keep commercial vacancies current on LoopNet MLS, including unit status, availability, renovations, and other relevant property information.

• Coordinate with the current architect when floor plans need to be updated because of changes to the property or individual units.

• Maintain accurate unit information across property marketing materials and internal records so vacancy information does not become outdated.

• Eventually take ownership of updating floor plans using AutoCAD or another floor plan editing tool.

Leasing Support

• Support the screening of new rental applications by gathering, organizing, and reviewing the required information before moving the application to the next step.

• Communicate with prospective tenants and applicants throughout the leasing process and respond to questions or missing information promptly.

• Assist with preparing lease documents and associated paperwork, ensuring required information is complete and organized.

• Coordinate move-in and move-out processes and ensure the necessary information, documents, and follow-ups are completed.

• Support lease renewal activity by tracking upcoming renewals and coordinating the required next steps.

Maintenance and Work Order Management

• When a tenant reports a maintenance issue, gather enough information to understand what is happening, determine the appropriate next step, and avoid sending incomplete information to Jennifer or a vendor.

• Coordinate with internal team and vendors when repairs or maintenance are required.

• Track open maintenance requests through completion and follow up when a vendor response, update, or repair is delayed.

• Keep work order information current so the team can see what has been reported, who is handling it, what action is pending, and whether the issue has been resolved.

• Escalate issues when the available information is insufficient, the situation requires a decision outside your authority, or progress has stalled.

Document Control

• Develop and maintain standardized formats for forms and documents used across the organization.

• Apply consistent document layouts, fonts, formatting, and other readability standards rather than creating documents with inconsistent presentation.

• Keep documents organized and accessible so the correct version can be located without unnecessary back-and-forth.

• Manage multiple documents simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

Tenant Concierge

• Respond to tenant and guest requests involving common areas, events, Wi-Fi access, and building access.

• Strong written and verbal English communication. You will communicate with tenants, applicants, vendors, architects, and internal stakeholders, so unclear or incomplete communication creates operational problems.

• Excellent proficiency in AppFolio or other property-management operational systems.

• Ability to manage multiple active property-management tasks and documents at the same time without losing track of follow-ups.

• Strong problem-solving ability. When a tenant reports an issue, you must be able to gather the relevant facts, identify the next action, and escalate appropriately instead of simply forwarding the complaint.

• Strong attention to detail, particularly when maintaining vacancy information, lease documentation, work orders, tenant records, and standardized documents.

• Ability to work independently in a remote, async environment and make routine execution decisions without requiring constant supervision.

• Ability to communicate early when an issue is blocked, information is missing, or a decision needs to be made by someone else.

• Comfort working across leasing, maintenance, tenant support, marketing, and document-management tasks rather than operating within a single narrow workflow.

TOOLS

• AppFolio

• LoopNet MLS

• Google Suite

• Slack
• Dropbox
• DocuSign
• AutoCAD or another floor plan editing software

WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT

• You close loops. When a tenant, applicant, vendor, or internal stakeholder needs something, you track the request through the next required action instead of assuming someone else will follow up.

• You can work from incomplete information. You know what questions to ask, what information is missing, and when an issue needs escalation.

• You communicate operationally. Updates should make it clear what happened, what is pending, who owns the next action, and when follow-up is required.

• You take ownership of recurring processes. Once a workflow is understood, you should be able to execute it consistently without requiring the same instructions repeatedly.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

• This is not a passive administrative VA role where you wait for someone to assign every next step.

• This is not a customer-service-only position. Tenant communication must be connected to actual property-management follow-through.

• This is not a pure leasing or sales position. The role also covers maintenance coordination, document control, property marketing, and tenant/building support.

• This is not a role where maintenance complaints are simply forwarded to the property manager or vendor without gathering information and tracking the issue.

• This is not a role for someone who is uncomfortable managing several open requests and documents at the same time.

  • Engagement Structure: Virtual/remote staffing engagement; specific engagement terms are provided during the hiring process

A tenant reports that their office has lost Wi-Fi access and says they have an important client meeting in one hour. They also mention that the building access door is intermittently failing. You have no immediate confirmation that either issue is affecting other tenants.

In 5–8 sentences, explain:

  1. What information you would gather first.
  2. Who you would contact or coordinate with.
  3. How you would prioritize the two issues.
  4. How you would track and communicate the status until resolution.

We are specifically looking for evidence of how you think through an active property-management issue, not a generic statement about being organized or proactive.

Job Description:

JOB OVERVIEW


The Business Development Manager, Truck & Equipment is responsible for driving B2B sales growth and expanding the customer base, delivering tailored leasing solutions and advancing services opportunities while developing skills and capabilities in a growing line of business. This role manages full‑cycle business development activities with direction and support, including prospecting, relationship development, solution presentation, negotiation, and deal closure.


Success in this role requires a growth mindset, strong initiative, and a commitment to continuous development. Additional duties may be assigned as needed.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Sales Development: Actively prospect and sign new clients to Wheels’ Truck & Equipment Division. Responsible for delivering against an annual order and revenue budget. Work with our Sales Excellence team and Fleet Consulting Executives to identify and research potential clients for leasing heavy trucks and equipment. Utilize various resources and networking channels to build a robust pipeline of leads.
  • Relationship Building: Identify key stakeholders within targeted prospects and establish and nurture strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders within client organizations, fostering trust and becoming a dependable partner.
  • Client Relationship Management: Establish and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients, understanding their specific needs and providing personalized solutions to meet their leasing requirements.
  • Consultative Approach: Employ a consultative selling approach to understand clients' pain points and objectives, demonstrating how our leasing and services can add value and address their business challenges effectively.
  • Quota Achievement: Meet and exceed assigned sales targets and key performance indicators (KPIs) on a consistent basis.
  • Sales Presentations: Develop and deliver compelling presentations to potential clients, highlighting the benefits and features of our leasing and services solutions.
  • Negotiation and Contracting: Negotiate terms and conditions with clients, prepare and close deals, and ensure smooth contract execution.
  • Sales Systems: Work with Operations, Contracts, and Syndication team to setup new lease schedules in Salesforce as assets are delivered. Support and maintain the Truck & Equipment systems, including Salesforce.
  • Lease Quoting: Develop and present lease quoting, including residual requests and follow-up, as directed by management.
  • Lead Qualification: Qualify prospects in targeted industries based on the Truck & Equipment group’s criteria.
  • Market Research: Keep abreast of Truck & Equipment industry trends, competitors, and emerging opportunities in the commercial leasing space to inform sales strategies.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Account Management, Syndications, and Operations, to ensure a seamless customer experience and achieve common business goals.

LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES

  • This position has no people leadership responsibility

COMPETENCIES - SKILLS

  • Growth Mindset: Open to learn and allow time to develop yourself, naturally motivated to compete in a positive way, and always look to the best way to achieve results.
  • Drive and Ambition: A strong desire to excel in a sales-driven environment, coupled with the ambition to continuously improve and achieve personal and organizational goals.
  • Customer Focus: An innate ability to understand customer needs and deliver tailored solutions, fostering long-lasting relationships and customer satisfaction because you care about it.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey the value proposition of our leasing and fleet management services to clients.
  • Resilience: The capacity to handle rejection and setbacks positively, maintaining a positive attitude and a persistent approach towards achieving sales objectives.
  • Adaptability: The flexibility to adapt sales strategies based on client feedback and changing market conditions to stay ahead of the competition.
  • Team Player: A collaborative individual, collaborating seamlessly with colleagues and sharing insights to drive collective success.
  • Integrity: An unwavering commitment to ethical business practices and transparent communication with clients and colleagues.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Sales, Marketing, or related fields (preferred but not required).
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of experience in sales or customer-facing roles
  • Be enthusiastic about trucks & equipment.
  • Proficiency in MS Office suite and CRM software.
  • Salesforce experience preferred
  • A valid driver's license and willingness to travel for client meetings or industry events.
  • Effective communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to understand and articulate complex solutions.
  • Initiative-taking, results-driven, and customer-focused mindset.
  • Adaptability to a dynamic and demanding environment.

CORE VALUES


At Wheels, we believe in fostering a culture that is built on our Core Values and Guiding Principles. We cultivate a culture of excellence and innovation by upholding these values, driving our collective success and growth.

  • Integrity – Always act with integrity and honesty.
  • One Team – Treat others with dignity and respect; act as a cohesive, inclusive and accountable team that is making a difference.
  • Innovation – Drive continuous improvement, spark creativity and embrace next generation thinking.
  • Customer Success – Ensure that customer and driver success is at the heart of everything we do.

CULTURAL ATTRIBUTES


At Wheels, our culture guides us how we work every day, and we look for team members who show these behaviors:


  • Discipline Drives Quality – Plan the Trip: Think proactively, hold a high bar, follow through by leveraging experience and systems. To produce quality outcomes, we must be intentional and deliberate in everything we do, from big bets to daily execution.
  • Intellectually Curious – Fuel Your Minds: Be bold, challenge assumptions, think differently, look outside the box. Strive to unlock your own thinking and create new possibilities.
  • Commit and Deliver – Own It: Take responsibility for your work, from start to finish, and be accountable for the results. Think and act like an owner of the business.
  • Relationships Matter – Share the Ride: Trust is central, both with key internal and external stakeholders. Relationships are not a side effect of work but a driver of success.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS, PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT


Work Environment: This is a fully remote position

Position Type/Standard Schedule: Full Time position - Monday thru Friday

Travel: Some travel is required for this position to visit clients and prospect as well as attending industry conferences and events

Physical Demands: Speak, hear, and see, and to use hand and fingers for computer keyboard and phone. Sit or stand for extended periods of time.
